topic.title: Bayesian Inference with Expensive or Misspecified Models
topic.overview: Scientific models may be easy to simulate yet expensive or impossible to evaluate as likelihoods. This topic studies sample-efficient posterior estimation, model comparison, likelihood-free inference, and predictive alternatives to the standard Bayesian posterior. It asks how to use a limited computation budget while being explicit about the inferential target.
topic.whyItMatters: An accurate approximation to a misspecified model’s posterior need not yield the best predictions. Conversely, optimizing predictive behavior changes what the resulting uncertainty represents. Distinguishing these objectives is important when choosing priors, comparing models, or interpreting parameter distributions derived from simulations.
topic.evolution: A 1996 Monte Carlo chaining method estimates relative model probabilities. Variational Bayesian Monte Carlo in 2018 combines active Gaussian-process quadrature with variational inference for costly likelihoods. Later work expands neural simulation-based methods; predictive variational inference in 2026 directly optimizes posterior predictive performance under scoring rules rather than necessarily approximating the conventional posterior.
openQuestions: How can inference budgets be allocated between exploring parameters and checking model mismatch?
Which uncertainty summaries remain meaningful when the posterior is optimized for prediction?

papers.title: Effortless, Simulation-Efficient Bayesian Inference using Tabular Foundation Models
papers.tldr: NPE-PFN uses pretrained TabPFN for Bayesian inference, often reducing simulation requirements while avoiding task-specific inference-network training.

papers.title: FNOPE: Simulation-based inference on function spaces with Fourier Neural Operators
papers.tldr: FNOPE combines Fourier Neural Operators and flow matching to infer uncertain functions efficiently from scientific simulations.

papers.title: Large Language Bayes
papers.tldr: Large Language Bayes generates and averages over formal models to make Bayesian predictions from data and an informal problem description.

papers.title: Multilevel neural simulation-based inference
papers.tldr: Multilevel simulation-based inference combines simulators of different costs and fidelities to improve accuracy within a fixed computing budget.

papers.title: Reverse-Annealed Sequential Monte Carlo for Efficient Bayesian Optimal Experiment Design
papers.tldr: Reverse-annealed SMC estimates experimental information gain with far fewer likelihood evaluations by starting from one posterior sample and moving toward the prior.

papers.title: Test Time Scaling for Neural Processes
papers.tldr: TTSNPs refine Neural Process latent samples at test time to improve predictions and uncertainty calibration without modifying the pretrained model.

papers.title: The Quotient Bayesian Learning Rule
papers.tldr: Quotient geometry extends parameterization-invariant Bayesian learning updates to non-exponential distributions represented as exponential-family marginals.

papers.title: Training-Free Bayesianization for Low-Rank Adapters of Large Language Models
papers.tldr: TFB adds Bayesian uncertainty to trained low-rank adapters by searching posterior variance without additional training.

papers.title: A Probabilistic Framework for LLM-Based Model Discovery
papers.tldr: ModelSMC organizes LLM-driven scientific model discovery as probabilistic inference over candidate mechanistic explanations.

papers.title: Accuracy and Normalized Accuracy under Length Bias: Analysis, Guidelines, and a Bayesian Alternative
papers.tldr: Bayesian accuracy uses an explicit answer-length prior to reduce multiple-choice evaluation bias without extra model forward passes.

papers.title: Amortized Simulation-Based Inference in Generalized Bayes via Neural Posterior Estimation
papers.tldr: A single neural estimator learns tempered Bayesian posteriors across observations and temperatures, enabling sampling without inference-time simulation or MCMC.

papers.title: Calibrated Test-Time Guidance for Bayesian Inference
papers.tldr: Consistent guidance estimators correct posterior-sampling failures in common diffusion guidance methods and improve evaluated Bayesian inference tasks.

papers.title: Efficient Bayesian Inference from Noisy Pairwise Comparisons
papers.tldr: BBQ improves rankings from pairwise human judgments by modeling rater reliability and providing calibrated uncertainty.

papers.title: Flow Matching Calibration for Simulation-Based Inference under Model Misspecification
papers.tldr: FMCPE uses a small calibration set and flow matching to correct simulation-trained posterior estimates under model mismatch.

papers.title: Gaussian Mean Field Variational Inference can Overestimate Predictive Variance
papers.tldr: In Bayesian linear regression, mean field inference can underestimate parameter variance while overestimating predictive variance where training data concentrates.

papers.title: JADAI: Jointly Amortizing Adaptive Design and Bayesian Inference
papers.tldr: JADAI jointly trains experiment selection and diffusion-based Bayesian inference to improve parameter estimation over adaptive experimental sequences.

papers.title: Minimum Distance Summaries for Robust Neural Posterior Estimation
papers.tldr: Minimum-distance summaries improve robustness by adapting test-time inputs to a pretrained posterior estimator using an MMD-based comparison.

papers.title: MIRA: A Score for Conditional Distribution Accuracy and Model Comparison
papers.tldr: MIRA assesses conditional distributions from joint samples and enables Bayesian model comparison through direct posterior validation.

papers.title: Multi-Task Bayesian In-Context Learning
papers.tldr: A Transformer uses prior-task datasets as context to adapt Bayesian predictions across prior families, matching evaluated oracle predictors much faster.

papers.title: Noisy-Channel Minimum Bayes Risk Decoding
papers.tldr: A noisy-channel decomposition exposes directional effects in MBR decoding and suggests that appropriate channel weighting may improve candidate selection.

papers.title: Online Bayesian Experimental Design for Partially Observed Dynamical Systems
papers.tldr: New information-gain estimators enable sequential Bayesian experiment selection for nonlinear systems with noisy, incomplete observations.

papers.title: Optimal Bayesian Stopping for Efficient Inference of Consistent LLM Answers
papers.tldr: A compact Bayesian stopping rule finds the most consistent LLM answer with fewer samples and has an asymptotic optimality guarantee.

papers.title: Predictive variational inference: Learn the predictively optimal posterior distribution
papers.tldr: Predictive variational inference learns a posterior for predictive quality, with uncertainty that can expose population heterogeneity and model mismatch.

papers.title: Proximal-IMH: Proximal Posterior Proposals for Independent Metropolis–Hastings with Approximate Operators
papers.tldr: Proximal-IMH locally corrects samples from a cheap approximate posterior to improve exact posterior sampling in Bayesian inverse problems.

papers.title: Scalable Simulation-Based Model Inference with Test-Time Complexity Control
papers.tldr: PRISM jointly infers simulator structures and parameters while allowing model-complexity preferences to change at test time.

papers.title: TabMGP: Martingale Posterior with TabPFN
papers.tldr: TabMGP turns TabPFN’s predictive rule into posterior uncertainty for scientific estimands, with near-nominal reported coverage.

papers.title: Tractable Expected Information Gains for Exponential Family Posteriors
papers.tldr: A sufficient exponential-family condition simplifies expected information gain and its gradient, enabling unbiased estimators with improved empirical convergence.
